threads.body: Looks like we don't run all tests with Java21 so not all of the metrics are listed. java21 only `jvm.thread.virtual.pinned` is included but for example `jvm.buffer.count` is missing. @jaydeluca is this fine? Should it run more tests to capture other metrics or should it be excluded from metadata collection?

replies.body: i think we should probably run more tests, i'll look more into it
